result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: a delivery fee value is rendering as NaN in the restaurant carousel.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card shows “€NaN delivery” instead of a valid delivery fee or free delivery label.
issues.suggestion: Fix the delivery fee data formatting/fallback logic so missing or invalid values display a sensible value such as “€0 delivery”, “Free delivery”, or “Delivery fee unavailable”.
